ITEM 1 | Loose pile of dark green, thin, ruffled leaves with serrated lobed edges and pale green stems, slightly glossy with light moisture, spread across the center-right of the plate covering roughly 35-40% of the plate surface, about 14 cm across and 4-5 cm tall in a loose mound, leaves sitting directly on the white plate with several small dark round pieces (about 1 cm) scattered among them | 60

ITEM 2 | Small dark purple-black whole round pieces, smooth and glossy with slight sheen, about 1 cm in diameter, five or six scattered among and at the edge of the leaf pile, sitting on top of and beside the greens | 5
